summary: Diff implements centralized web branding config, adds an in-web Install App entry point/page, and updates Android wrapper resources/manifest toward consistent branding. However, the Android wrapper README is truncated in the diff summary so key sideload/Gradle-property/build/install instructions cannot be confirmed, and the browser tab title for logged-out users likely remains the static index.html title because AppLayout (which sets document.title) is only used inside the authenticated router.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update Android wrapper documentation for non–Play Store (sideload) distribution, including: explicit sideload section, exact Gradle property `nutriscan.baseUrl` with example, steps to build a release APK/AAB, and end-user APK installation steps.
missing_requirements.reason: The README diff is truncated right after 'Edit `gradle.properties`:' and does not show the required Gradle property (`nutriscan.baseUrl`) example, release build commands/Android Studio steps, or end-user sideload installation steps; cannot verify they were added.

missing_requirements.requirement: Single place to change the display name for the web app, updating all existing UI locations including browser tab title (including on the login page).
missing_requirements.reason: The tab title in `frontend/index.html` remains 'Nutrition Tracker', and the code that sets `document.title` is in `AppLayout`, which is only rendered inside the router (authenticated flow). When logged out, `AuthGate` returns `LoginPage` directly, so the tab title likely does not update to the configured display name for logged-out users.
